Maya (PM): Quick sync — AtlasHealth requested a private-preview with per-route throttles, structured audit logs, and a rollback SLA. Need to decide beta commitments.
Rob (Eng Lead): We can ship per-route throttles (tokens + concurrent sessions) and audit logs in ~6 weeks if scoped tightly. Rollback SLA: offer manual rollback runbook for beta; automated cross-region failover is GA work.
Tess (Design): Atlas wants a console knob + API examples. I can mock a minimal UI in 3 days using existing route config components.
Devon (Customer Success): Atlas will only commit to pilot if we provide a launch criteria doc, onboarding cadence, and sample outputs for compliance review. NDA might be required.
Sasha (Research): I can own an eval harness (50-primer prompt set) and an automated regression check. Will need Atlas prompt list to accelerate.
Maya (PM): Proposed split: MUST = throttles (token/concurrency), audit logs (structured), eval harness + 50 prompts, launch criteria doc, 2-week onboarding support. NICE = console UI, cross-region rollback SLA, managed sampling pipeline.
Rob (Eng Lead): Agree. Audit log schema needs fields: timestamp, request_id, route_id, user_id, model, tokens_in/out, decision_flags. Also retention defaults and KMS hooks for Private. I'll draft spec. Estimate must-have 6w; nice +4w.
Tess (Design): UX note: default throttle should be conservative. Tooltip: "Start conservative; increase after onboarding". I'll include example curl and SDK snippets.
Devon (Customer Success): Launch criteria proposal: 1) Eval harness passes (no regressions > 5% on their prompts), 2) Load test: sustained 200 rps, 300ms P95, 3) Audit logs capture token-level attribution + metadata, 4) Onboarding plan with daily check-ins first week.
Maya (PM): Good. For the rollback SLA, beta offer: manual rollback within 2 hours (on-call runbook). We'll push automated failover for GA.
Rob (Eng Lead): Also note capacity: recommend dedicated pool commit levels and burst config; will include autoscale policy suggestions.
Sasha (Research): I'll export sample outputs to a secure bucket with tags for traceability; need legal OK.
Devon (Customer Success): I'll confirm NDA scope and ask Atlas for the priority prompt set and compliance contacts.
ops-bot: Reminder — "DP scope negotiation" meeting scheduled 2025-07-08 10:00 AM in #product. (meeting-link)
Maya (PM): Action items: Rob -> throttle + audit spec by Tue; Tess -> console mock by Thu; Sasha -> eval harness draft by Fri; Devon -> NDA + Atlas prompts by Fri. I'll draft launch criteria doc and timeline.
Rob (Eng Lead): Starting a draft PR in eng-repo and will include reviewers.
Tess (Design): Will post mocks to the design board and add notes for default values.
Devon (Customer Success): Will loop in Atlas PM after NDA.
Sasha (Research): Will tag all eval artifacts for regression tracking.
Maya (PM): Thanks everyone — I'll post the spec link in this channel when ready. :thumbsup:
